extracted_text: If the requirement of consideration is met, there is no additional requirement of (a) a gain, advantage, or benefit to the promisor or a loss, disadvantage, or detriment to the promisee; or (b) equivalence in the values exchanged; or (c) mutuality of obligation.
axiom_summary: Once the bargained-for exchange element is satisfied, adequacy/equivalence of value is irrelevant and benefit-detriment is not an independent test.
